        ))?
        $
        """, re.VERBOSE)",

}

The hidden tests failing on test_should_parse_cli_arguments suggest that the CLI argument parsing is not working as expected. Also, the agent removed the --cov options from setup.cfg, which might affect test collection but not the hidden tests.
